name: w_data_quality
meaning: share of key inputs from a report/live source vs estimated or fallback

name: w_model_agreement
meaning: how closely the weather early-warning prior matches the soil-report rating

name: w_interval_tightness
meaning: how narrow the yield prediction interval is relative to the point estimate

name: w_in_distribution
meaning: fraction of inputs within the 5th-95th percentile of the training data

name: w_feedback_support
meaning: how many verified local farmer reports back this crop/region up

name: w_satellite_agreement
meaning: whether satellite vegetation signals agree with the soil-report rating

name: soil_report_age_penalty_years
meaning: soil test results older than this many years lose data_quality credit

name: band_high_min
meaning: score at or above this is HIGH confidence

name: band_medium_min
meaning: score at or above this (and below band_high_min) is MEDIUM confidence
